commandsContradiction: `runInit` is invoked with the resolved repo root and translated options. In JSON mode the result object is emitted as-is; otherwise `formatHuman` renders it. When `--batch` was used and JSON was not requested, `process.exitCode` is set to `batchExitCode`. Errors set `process.exitCode = 1` (the comment notes that `process.exit(1)` is avoided because abrupt exit can trigger libuv STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN on Windows while async handles are still open).

`registerVerify` attaches `livewiki verify`. It runs the core validator and either writes JSON (`VerifyResult`) or the human formatter. CI-friendly: if `result.ok` is `false`, `process.exitCode` is set to `1`. Errors during the run set `process.exitCode = 1` after writing to stderr (avoiding `process.exit(1)` so Node drains pending stderr I/O).
